title: Dwarven Halls
summary: A ruined dwarven city under the mountains, reached by a long stairwell. The Forgeguard, the Iron Thane, and the Runeforged gear.

s.x: The Dwarven Halls are a ruined dwarven city, built into the rock under mountains, hills and forests. You enter through a broken stone gate on a hillside and walk down a very long spiral stair into forge halls, barracks, rail stations and vaults lit by glowing runes. Lost Miners and clockwork Constructs still guard it. It is the fourth dungeon, and its boss,
, drops the runes for the Thane's Hammer and the Runeforged set.

The halls run deep, so budget for a long walk and a long climb out. Use the waystone at the gate to come back.
From the gate, a square-spiral stair of about 76 blocks goes down, with landings that hold packs, chests and arrow traps. It leaves through an east door at the bottom.

s.x: A standard pack on floor 1 is 3 Lost Miners, 2 Archers and 1 Construct. On floor 2 it is 2 Miners, 2 Archers and 2 Constructs.
Constructs shrug off arrows (half damage). Fight them in melee or with an ability, and use bows on Miners and Archers. Their punch lifts you off your feet, so do not stand with your back to a drop.
Three pressure plates. The sign says "Three plates. One door. The ancestors keep the hoard." Step on all three to open the door.
(floor 2). Three levers with a sign: "Down. Up. Down. The runes obey the old order." Set the levers down, up, down to open the door.
A sign reads "The vault is sealed behind iron and rune. Bring the Thane's Key." The key opens it.

s.x: At two thirds he stamps his hammer and the Forgeguard answers. At one third "his crown ignites" and the floor runs molten.

Phase 1 is a tank-and-spank. Stand on his flank and step out of each slam ring. In phase 2, kill the Forgeguard summons before they box you in, and use a ranged attack on the Miners. In phase 3 the floor is the danger: when "the floor glows red-hot", move. Leave the glowing spots before the burn starts, and never stand still in the Deep Forge.

Bring ore-mining gear: the halls have Duskquartz walls you can mine as you go. Kill an Elite Lost Miner or the Forgeguard for the Thane's Key, then open the vault before the fight so you know what you are fighting for.
Fight the Constructs in melee, not with arrows.
The Thane's pull and shockwave move you around the arena. Keep out of the lava-red spots and do not stand still in the last phase.
